scripts.text:
[Oscar]
The captain sneaked in the control panel room.
Move quietly.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
船长潜入了控制面板室。
请保持安静行动。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The door is normally locked with the security system, so I have to stay there and work with the controller.
As you can see most of the entrances have been blocked already.
Hi
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这扇门通常由安保系统锁定，所以我必须留在这里操作控制器。
如你所见，大部分入口已经被封锁了。
嗨

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It will take some time to go through them one by one.
I'll keep helping you through the intercom.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
逐一突破它们需要一些时间。
我会通过通讯器继续协助你。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
You'll have to go through the restaurant to reach the hallway.
Est will be performing the operation alone.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你需要穿过餐厅才能到达走廊。
埃斯特将独自执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
If there's a disturbance, Est may have caused it. So please check out with her before continuing.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
如果发生骚动，可能是埃斯特引起的。所以在继续前进之前，请先与她确认情况。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
You should go now adventurer. I'll keep working on securing the security controller.
There may be researchers detained inside.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
现在该出发了，冒险者。我会继续处理安保控制器。
里面可能还有被扣押的研究员。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Please consider their safety first.
Now go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
请优先考虑他们的安全。
现在出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
The biometric scan is still operational, I'll be staying here to keep the door open.
If you're in a hurry, please go...
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
生物识别扫描仍在运行，我会留在这里保持门开着。
如果你赶时间，请快去吧...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Are you the one who removed the poison gas outside?
You arrived at a good time.
Because of the gas, the door was forcibly locked down!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
是你解除了外面的毒气吗？
你来得正是时候。
因为毒气，这扇门被强制锁死了！

scripts.text:
[Est]
It takes time for Aas to come hack the controller and release the gas.
I was going to do it myself.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
阿斯需要时间来破解控制器并释放毒气。
我本来打算自己处理的。

scripts.text:
[Est]
The guards here were wearing the same clothes as those Heart Hunters we saw before.
I don't think I can save all the researchers alone.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
这里的卫兵穿着和之前那些心之猎手一样的衣服。
我觉得我一个人无法救出所有研究员。

scripts.text:
[Est]
It seems we've gathered most of them here already.
Let's organize our next strategy.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
看起来我们已经把大多数人聚集到这里了。
让我们制定下一步的策略吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
There are laboratories on the other side and it's likely to be a mess.
I wonder if there will be a big fight.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
另一边是实验室，那里很可能一片混乱。
不知道会不会有一场大战。

scripts.text:
[Est]
From now on the Rebellion Special Forces will prioritize on rescuing the Detained Researchers.
If you get it, move quickly!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
从现在开始，反叛者特种部队将优先营救被扣押的研究员。
明白了就快点行动！

scripts.text:
[Est]
Okay, adventurer, find a communication device and get in contact with Aas.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
好的，冒险者，找一个通讯设备，联系阿斯。

scripts.text:
[Est]
You have to open the entrance of the private labs.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你必须打开私人实验室的入口。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Huh. We'll focus on rescuing the hostages first.
Look for the Security Guard's room that Aas talked about.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
嗯。我们要先集中力量营救人质。
去找阿斯提到的保安室。

scripts.text:
Code is inactive.
The communication has been terminated.
scripts.translation:
代码未激活。
通讯已终止。

scripts.text: Voice Transmission Connected.
scripts.translation: 语音传输已连接。

scripts.text:
Code is inactive.
The communication has been terminated.
scripts.translation:
代码未激活。
通讯已终止。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Hey, Did you check all the labs yet?
Please check if there are still Detained Researchers.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
嘿，你检查完所有实验室了吗？
请确认是否还有被扣押的研究员。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The spare Master Key still remains.
Without it, I wouldn't have been able to control over the security systems. Are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
备用主钥匙还在。
没有它，我就无法控制安保系统。你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Now you only need to check the Central Room.
Did you say Heart Hunters?
The traitors from Schlein have already escaped.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
现在你只需要去检查中枢室。
你说心之猎手？
施莱因的那些叛徒已经逃走了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
We've got our focus on that room.
That's the main idea.
Where is Est?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我们的重点就是那个房间。
这是主要思路。
埃斯特在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
You have to keep looking for all the Researchers?
That's necessary, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你必须继续寻找所有研究员？
我明白，这是必要的。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Adventurer, we head to the Central Room.
Meet me over there.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
冒险者，我们要去中枢室。
在那边等我。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Adventurer, we head to the Central Room.
Meet me over there.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
冒险者，我们要去中枢室。
在那边等我。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
My... my search... materials...
They took it all!
They took everything!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
我的...我的研究...资料...
他们全拿走了！
他们把一切都拿走了！

scripts.text:
Oh, you're here to protect me?
I'll go with you, thank you!
scripts.translation:
哦，你是来保护我的？
我跟你走，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Oh, you're there to protect me?
I'll go with you, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
哦，你是来保护我的？
我跟你走，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
I thought they kicked out all the crazy guy...
I hit the back of my head like this.
Tsk.
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
我以为他们把那个疯子赶走了...
结果我后脑勺被这样打了一下。
啧。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Are you here to save us?
Get me out of here!
We couldn't flee because they put poisonous gas outside the doors!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
你是来救我们的？
快带我出去！
他们在门外放了毒气，我们逃不出去！

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Yeah, I know a little bit about the Heart Hunters, I will tell you everything!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
是的，我了解一些关于心之猎手的事，我会把一切都告诉你！

scripts.text:
[Est]
Ah? Do you have more information to share?
Do you want to go outside and talk about it calmly with me?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
啊？你还有更多信息要分享吗？
你想出去冷静地和我谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'll take this guy out of here and you look at the other rooms.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我把这个人带出去，你去检查其他房间。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Please help me!
I worked a lot and I'm not getting paid!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
请帮帮我！
我工作很努力，却拿不到工资！

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Schlein, where is Schlein?
He's a traitor!
I've seen it with my own eyes, he just killed the guards...
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
施莱因，施莱因在哪里？
他是叛徒！
我亲眼看见他杀了卫兵...

scripts.text: Calm down.
scripts.translation: 冷静点

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Is it safe now?
I'm glad when I was hired at Rekenber, but what the hell is going with such a big company...
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
现在安全了吗？
我很高兴被雷肯伯格录用，但这么大的一家公司到底在搞什么鬼...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Say what? The Rebellions are coming to save us?
Can't I just run away with you instead?
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
你说什么？反叛者来救我们？
我能不能直接跟着你逃跑？

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Oh... you're part of the recon team?
Alright. I'll wait for the rescue team.
Many people escaped by breaking the windows and ran away..
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
哦...你是侦察队的一员？
好吧。我会等救援队。
很多人打破窗户逃走了...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Oh you already know.
Okay. I'll be quiet now and wait.
Your uniform is really cool though.
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
哦，你已经知道了。
好吧。我现在会安静下来等待的。
不过，你的制服真的很酷。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
I know. I know.
If I wait here, will the Rebellions come and save me?
I'll be fine then.
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
我知道，我知道。
如果我在这里等，反叛者会来救我吗？
那样的话我就没事了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
But again, your uniform is really cool.
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
但是再说一次，你的制服真的很酷。

scripts.text:
This is the list of the Enterprise security teams.
Some have circles around them... others are crossed out.
scripts.translation:
这是企业安保小队的名单。
有些人被圈了起来...其他人则被划掉了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
The ones circled are probably those who accepted to be recruited...
My team is the one with a X marked next to it.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
被圈起来的应该是那些同意被招募的人...
我的小队旁边标了一个X。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It's a mercenary contract...
There's a rough plan for the day of the raid.
I can't believe it came to this...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这是一份佣兵契约...
还有突袭当天的粗略计划。
真不敢相信事情会发展到这一步...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
This is meant to provoke me.
It won't work this time. I'll track this to the end.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这是为了挑衅我。
这次不会得逞的。我会追查到底。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I'd better take it back to Tess and analyze it.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我最好把它带回去给泰丝解析一下。

scripts.text:
I've already got the data here.
There's nothing else to see here.
scripts.translation:
我已经拿到数据了。
这里没有其他值得看的东西了。

scripts.text: The device does not work.
scripts.translation: 该装置无法正常工作。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
That's the Central Room right ahead.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
正前方就是中枢室。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Wait.
scripts.translation: 等待

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Please speak to me when you're ready.
I don't know why, but it's tightly closed;. It takes some time to maintain access.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
请准备好后与我对话。
不知道为什么，它被紧紧锁住了。维持访问权限需要一些时间。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
As confirmed by the security system, nothing is being detected on the inside...
I still want to confirm inside the room regardless.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
安保系统确认，内部没有检测到任何动静...
但我还是想亲自进去确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
First I'll need to disable the auto-locking mechanism, and then I'll follow right away.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
首先我需要解除自动锁定机制，然后我会立刻跟上。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I don't believe there are any enemies left inside, I'm going to pull out.
Just check the Central Room and then get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我不认为里面还有敌人了，我要撤了。
检查一下中枢室，然后离开。

scripts.text:
This device has an unknown purpose.
There are four buttons in the room.
scripts.translation:
这个装置的用途不明。
房间里有四个按钮。

scripts.text:
This device has an unknown purpose.
There are four buttons in the room.
scripts.translation:
这个装置的用途不明。
房间里有四个按钮。

scripts.text: Press the button.
scripts.translation: 按下按钮

scripts.text:
This device has an unknown purpose.
There are four buttons in the room.
scripts.translation:
这个装置的用途不明。
房间里有四个按钮。

scripts.text: Red Button.
scripts.translation: 红色按钮

scripts.text: Blue Button.
scripts.translation: 蓝色按钮

scripts.text: White Button.
scripts.translation: 白色按钮

scripts.text: Yellow Button.
scripts.translation: 黄色按钮

scripts.text: This device has already been activated.
scripts.translation: 该装置已被启动。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Est has handled everything else on the inside.
Sorry for not being able to help you at all.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
埃斯特已经处理了内部的其他事务。
抱歉没能帮上你什么忙。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Let's go back to Einbroch.
I'll... I'll go to my office and join you.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我们回艾音布罗克吧。
我...我会去办公室和你汇合。

scripts.text: Move to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 前往艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Move to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 前往里希塔乐镇

scripts.text: Stay for a while.
scripts.translation: 稍作停留

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Do you have anything else to investigate?
I'll wait  here.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你还有其他需要调查的事情吗？
我就在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
We're going to wait for you in the Cat on Bullet.
Please head there and meet us in the headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我们会在“猫与子弹”上等你。
请前往那里，在总部与我们汇合。

scripts.text: An unknown entity has been detected. Access Denied.
scripts.translation: 检测到未知实体。访问被拒绝。

scripts.text: An unknown entity has been detected. Access Denied.
scripts.translation: 检测到未知实体。访问被拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
Why do I have to feed this traitors?
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
我为什么要给这些叛徒喂食？

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
I want to go home... I just want to go home...
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
我想回家...我只想回家...

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
Are you here to save us?
Thank you! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
你是来救我们的吗？
谢谢！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
What the hell is happening?
Aaaah... I just want to go home...
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
到底发生了什么？
啊啊...我只想回家...

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
Why did you come here to save me?
The Enterprise's guards... no wait...
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
你为什么要来这里救我？
企业的卫兵...不对...

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
I thought that you were the one who kept us in custody...!
Why would they do that?
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
我还以为是你把我们扣押在这里的...！
他们为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
These scumbags took my Research Report and I escaped here.
It was a spray repellent to block blood-sucking insects!
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
这些混蛋拿走了我的研究报告，我逃到了这里。
那是一种用来阻挡吸血昆虫的喷雾剂！

scripts.text:
[Detained Researcher]
That was my private research, I don't know why they took it!
You can't just take away someone else's Research Report.
scripts.translation:
[被扣押的研究员]
那是我的私人研究，我不知道他们为什么要拿走！
不能随便拿走别人的研究报告。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I've come prepared, but this was easier than thought.
Now I'm stuck here. Hehehehe!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我做好了准备，但这比想象中容易多了。
现在我被困在这里了。嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
The remaining researchers are gathered here for their security.
The Rebellions will protect them and help them escape.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
幸存的研究员们为了安全都聚集在这里。
反叛者会保护他们并协助他们逃离。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I thought they had less forces on the inside, but I didn't think they'd have installed toxic gas.
Most people have fled already, only the enemies are remaining.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我以为内部的人手没那么多，没想到他们竟然安装了有毒瓦斯。
大多数人已经逃走了，只剩下敌人还在里面。

scripts.text:
It is a data on new efficiency and side effect of new potions.
However there is information about the core ingredients.
scripts.translation:
这是关于新药剂的效率与副作用的数据。
不过其中包含了核心成分的信息。

scripts.text:
Some of the drawing has been torn.
Somebody intentionally destroyed the relevant parts.
scripts.translation:
部分图纸被撕毁了。
有人故意销毁了相关部分。

scripts.text:
Parts of the documents were severely damaged.
It seems to have been about attempting to create a device using the refraction of light.
scripts.translation:
文件的部分内容严重受损。
看起来是关于尝试利用光的折射制造某种装置的。

scripts.text:
Lloyds's enchantment and processing data.
Only the title was left, all the text was removed.
scripts.translation:
劳埃德的附魔与加工数据。
只剩下标题，正文内容全被删除了。

scripts.text: The booklet is missing some pages. Someone has deliberately omitted the material.
scripts.translation: 小册子缺了几页。有人故意删去了相关内容。

scripts.text: The experimental data has been removed. There are clear traces of someone destroying the information.
scripts.translation: 实验数据已被移除。有明显的痕迹表明有人销毁了这些信息。
